verdicts.decision_note: The client authorizes configuration of the alternate Meta account for advertising access; the administrative meeting date is not included in the Event.
The client identifies the cousin as the alternate account owner and specifies that the account must provide advertising access.
The client unambiguously acknowledges the identity-verification artifacts and image format required for the alternate-account setup.
The response defines the initial login procedure, cousin participation, and two-factor-authentication configuration for account access.
The response defines the authentication workflow: the cousin supplies initial two-factor codes and an additional email enables the client's ongoing login access.
